fortress.name: Belgrade Fortress
fortress.price_text: Free to walk; small fees for some museums inside
fortress.hours: Park always open; museums usually 10:00–17:00, closed Monday — check on the day
fortress.tip: Enter from Knez Mihailova via Kalemegdan Park and stay for the sunset over the Sava and Danube.

knez.name: Knez Mihailova Street
knez.tip: Pedestrian street linking Republic Square to the fortress — walk it once by day and once in the evening.

st-sava.name: St. Sava Temple
st-sava.tip: Go down to the crypt for the mosaics, and dress modestly as it is an active church.

skadarlija.name: Skadarlija
skadarlija.price_text: Free to walk; meals roughly 1,500–3,500 RSD
skadarlija.hours: Street always open; restaurants from about 11:00 to late
skadarlija.tip: Cobbled old bohemian quarter — book a table for live music in the evening and expect slow service.

tesla.name: Nikola Tesla Museum
tesla.price_text: Small entry fee — check on the day; guided tours run hourly
tesla.hours: Usually Tue–Sun, roughly 10:00–18:00 — check on the day
tesla.tip: Entry is by guided tour only, so arrive a little before the hour to join the next one.

sava-river.name: Sava River promenade
sava-river.tip: Walk the Savamala bank at sunset, then cross to the splavs (floating clubs) for the night.

rajko-mitic.name: Stadion Rajko Mitić
rajko-mitic.price_text: Match tickets vary — check on the day
rajko-mitic.hours: Only on match days or by tour — check on the day
rajko-mitic.tip: Home of Red Star; if a match is on, go with a local and sit in a calm section.

cevapcici.name: Ćevapčići (grilled minced meat)
cevapcici.tip: Order them in a lepinja flatbread with kajmak and raw onion — a cheap, filling meal.

zemun-quay.name: Zemun quay (Kej oslobođenja)
zemun-quay.tip: Riverside walk with fish restaurants and views back to the fortress — go at sunset.

skadarlija-market.name: Bajloni green market
skadarlija-market.price_text: Free to browse; fruit and cheese by weight
skadarlija-market.hours: Mornings, roughly 06:00–15:00 — check on the day
skadarlija-market.tip: Buy fresh cheese, kajmak and seasonal fruit here for a picnic in the fortress park.

savamala.name: Savamala neighbourhood walk
savamala.tip: Gritty riverside district of street art, galleries and bars — walk it before the nightlife starts.

splavovi.name: Splavovi (floating river clubs)
splavovi.price_text: Entry often free; drinks roughly 400–800 RSD
splavovi.tip: Clubs on barges along the Sava — go with friends and agree a meeting point before you split up.

kalemegdan-view.name: Kalemegdan viewpoint over the confluence
kalemegdan-view.tip: Best free view in the city — the Sava meets the Danube below you, with Novi Beograd beyond.

tram-tour.name: Old town walking tour
tram-tour.price_text: Free tours tip-based, roughly 1,000–2,000 RSD tip
tram-tour.hours: Usually daily late morning — check on the day
tram-tour.tip: Two hours on foot covers Republic Square, Knez Mihailova and the fortress with local context.

usce.name: Ušće park and riverbank
usce.tip: Green riverside park at the confluence — good for a flat walk or a bike ride.

ada.name: Ada Ciganlija lake beach
ada.hours: Always open; swimming season roughly June–September
ada.tip: Belgrade's city beach on an island lake — busy and lively in summer, quiet walks off-season.

zeleni-venac.name: Zeleni venac market
zeleni-venac.price_text: Free to browse; produce by weight
zeleni-venac.hours: Mornings, roughly 06:00–15:00 — check on the day
zeleni-venac.tip: Cheap local produce and a good look at everyday Belgrade life; bring small cash.

rakija-bar.name: Rakija bar evening
rakija-bar.tip: Try a flight of fruit brandies (rakija) and ask staff to explain the difference.

museum-yugoslavia.name: Museum of Yugoslavia
museum-yugoslavia.price_text: Small entry fee — check on the day
museum-yugoslavia.hours: Usually Tue–Sun, roughly 10:00–17:00 — check on the day
museum-yugoslavia.tip: Covers Yugoslav history and Tito's grave; allow more time than you expect.

dorcol-walk.name: Dorćol neighbourhood walk
dorcol-walk.hours: Always open; cafés daytime, bars evening
dorcol-walk.tip: Old quarter of cafés, bakeries and street life between the fortress and the Danube.

boat-cruise.name: Sava and Danube boat cruise
boat-cruise.price_text: Roughly 1,000–2,000 RSD — check on the day
boat-cruise.hours: Daytime and sunset departures in season
boat-cruise.tip: An hour on the water shows the fortress and confluence from below — book at the quay.

gardo.name: Gardoš Tower (Millennium Tower)
gardo.price_text: Small fee to climb — check on the day
gardo.hours: Daytime only — check on the day
gardo.tip: Climb for the best view over Zemun rooftops and the Danube.
